# INCOMPLETE licence records

Listed rather than reconstructed. `tools/deps/forge_deps.py notices` states the rule
in its own header: *"Nothing here is transcribed from memory; a license text that is
not on disk is reported as an INCOMPLETE record rather than reconstructed."* A licence
notice written from memory is exactly the kind of artefact that looks compliant and
is not.

## CLOSED 2026-09-18 — Dear ImGui and the two fonts it embeds

The Dear ImGui entry that stood here is closed. `DearImGui-MIT.txt` is now vendored
beside this file, fetched from upstream rather than transcribed, and the packager
stages it into the bundle. See `README.md` for the provenance table.

Closing it surfaced **three further obligations that were never recorded at all**,
because the earlier record described the component and not the artifact. Dear ImGui
does not ship alone:

| what actually ships | copyright, as it appears in the vendored source | licence text now here |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Dear ImGui `v1.92.9 WIP` | `imgui.cpp:30` — `Copyright (c) 2014-2026 Omar Cornut` | `DearImGui-MIT.txt` |
| **ProggyClean.ttf**, embedded bitmap font, ~9 KB of the binary | `imgui_draw.cpp:6358` — `MIT License / Copyright (c) 2004, 2005 Tristan Grimmer` | `ProggyClean-MIT.txt` |
| **ProggyForever-Regular-minimal.ttf**, embedded vector font, ~14 KB | `imgui_draw.cpp:6548` — `MIT license / Copyright (c) 2026 Disco Hello, Copyright (c) 2019,2023 Tristan Grimmer` | `ProggyForever-MIT.txt` |
| **stb** — `imstb_rectpack.h`, `imstb_textedit.h`, `imstb_truetype.h` | `Copyright (c) 2017 Sean Barrett`, dual MIT / Unlicense | `stb-MIT-or-Unlicense.txt` |

The two fonts are compiled into `forge_desktop` as byte arrays and are **not**
disabled: `forge-desktop/third_party/imgui/imconfig.h:53-55` carries
`IMGUI_DISABLE_DEFAULT_FONT`, `..._BITMAP` and `..._VECTOR` all commented out, and
ImGui's own comment beside them states the byte cost each would remove. So they ship,
they carry their own MIT notices with copyright holders who are not Omar Cornut, and
MIT requires those notices to accompany the distribution.

★The previous record cited the wrong file. It attributed
`Copyright (c) 2014-2026 Omar Cornut` and `See LICENSE.txt ...` to `imgui.h`.
**`imgui.h` contains no copyright or licence string at all** — verify with
`grep -in 'copyright\|licen' forge-desktop/third_party/imgui/imgui.h`, which prints
nothing. Both strings are in `imgui.cpp:30-32`. The text of the claim was right and
its citation was not, which in a provenance record is the whole of the value.

## Still owed — `NOTICES.md` entries for components that ship

`third_party/notices/NOTICES.md` covers opencascade, boost, planegcs, node-addon-api,
vulkan-headers, vulkan-loader, glslang, molten-vk. Components that **ship** and are
still missing from it:

- **SDL2** — dynamic dylib staged into `Contents/Frameworks`. Licence text is
  vendored here as `SDL2-zlib.txt`; the notices entry is still owed.
- **Dear ImGui, ProggyClean, ProggyForever, stb** — static, in `forge_desktop`.
  Licence texts are vendored here and ship in the bundle, which is the obligation
  MIT actually imposes. The notices entry is still owed.

★These are owed by the GENERATOR, not by this directory, and that is why they are
not simply typed in. `NOTICES.md` says in its own header *"GENERATED by
`tools/deps/forge_deps.py notices` — do not edit by hand"*, and it is built from
`third_party/manifest/deps.lock.json`. **Every component it can describe is one
resolved through the lock; a component vendored as source in-tree has no lock entry,
so the generator cannot see it at all.** Hand-writing the section would make the file
disagree with its own generator on the next run and would violate the repo invariant
against mutating generated data as source. Closing this means teaching
`forge_deps.py` about in-tree vendored components — a change to the generator and to
the lock schema, not to this file.

(The audit that surfaced this said the manifest omits three components. planegcs is
NOT one of them — it is present, as `## planegcs freecad-0a45a0a`. Checked.)
